therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: c-MET inhibition + EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: overcoming EGFR inhibitor resistance mediated by c-MET amplification
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: EGFR mutated, c-MET-amplified NSCLC patients who progressed after EGFR inhibitor treatment

results.effect_size: ORR: 12/53 (22.6%) for capsule formulation, 17/47 (36.2%) for tablet formulation
results.target_engagement_evidence: Median -100% reduction in c-MET H score at 100mg QD and 400mg BID capsule doses, -31% reduction at 400mg BID capsule Phase II dose
biomarker_changes: c-MET H score reduction: -100% (100mg QD), -100% (400mg BID capsule Phase Ib), -31% (400mg BID capsule Phase II)
subgroup_findings: Tablet formulation showed higher ORR (36.2%) compared to capsule formulation (22.6%)
safety_signals: Grade 3/4 AEs in 24/53 (45.3%) capsule patients and 35/47 (74.5%) tablet patients
DLTs included cough, dizziness, and dyspnoea at higher doses
Serious AEs included cardiac disorders, febrile neutropenia, thrombocytopenia
results.dose_information: INC280: escalating doses from 100mg QD to 600mg BID in Phase Ib, 400mg BID recommended Phase II dose; Gefitinib: 250mg once daily

context.duration: Up to 60.8 weeks treatment, up to 70.2 months follow-up
